text: {"final": {"findings": [{"id": "R1", "statement": "eligibility/rules.py defines QUALIFYING_SCORE = 60 and PREGNANCY_QUALIFYING_SCORE = 45, and threshold_for(household: Household) -> int returns PREGNANCY_QUALIFYING_SCORE if has_pregnant_member(household) else QUALIFYING_SCORE. A near-miss threshold must therefore be per-household, not a single constant.", "file": "eligibility/rules.py"}, {"id": "R2", "statement": "is_eligible(household: Household, score: int | None = None, today=None) -> bool returns False when household.status != \"active\"; otherwise it computes score = vulnerability_score(household, today) if score is None, and returns score >= threshold_for(household). Eligibility is inclusive of the threshold (>=).", "file": "eligibility/rules.py"}, {"id": "R3", "statement": "vulnerability_score(household: Household, today=None) -> int in eligibility/scoring.py returns min(100, sum(score_breakdown(household, today).values())). This is the household's vulnerability score the ticket refers to.", "file": "eligibility/scoring.py"}, {"id": "R4", "statement": "score_breakdown(household: Household, today=None) -> dict[str, int] computes points from POINTS: child_under_5 = 8 per child up to 3, elder_over_65 = 10 per elder up to 2, pregnant = 10, disability = 15, shelter_damaged = 20, income_lost = 15, large_household = 10 if household.size >= 6. Ages come from Member.age_on(day) using today or config.settings.today(). Zero-valued parts are omitted from the dict.", "file": "eligibility/scoring.py"}, {"id": "R5", "statement": "Household (core/models.py) has status: str = \"active\" (active | inactive | merged), members: list[Member], size property = len(self.members), and boolean flags shelter_damaged, income_lost, disability. Member has pregnant: bool and age_on(day) -> int (completed years).", "file": "core/models.py"}, {"id": "R6", "statement": "No function named needs_review, or anything matching 'near', exists anywhere in the codebase; the new function must be written from scratch in eligibility/rules.py.", "file": "eligibility/rules.py"}, {"id": "R7", "statement": "Existing edge-case tests in tests/test_eligibility.py show the boundary behavior to preserve: a household with score 58 (shelter_damaged 20 + income_lost 15 + disability 15 + child_under_5 8) is not eligible at threshold 60; a pregnant household with score 45 (shelter_damaged 20 + disability 15 + pregnant 10) is eligible at threshold 45. So near-miss means score < threshold_for(household) but score >= threshold_for(household) - 5, and already-eligible households (score >= threshold) must not be flagged.", "file": "tests/test_eligibility.py"}, {"id": "R8", "statement": "has_pregnant_member(household: Household) -> bool in eligibility/rules.py returns any(m.pregnant for m in household.members); it can be reused to determine which threshold applies.", "file": "eligibility/rules.py"}]}}
